name: Straya Studio Design Tokens
description: Centralized design system for Straya Studio — Brutalist Canvas Edition. Single source of truth for tokens.css.

_doc.philosophy: The page is a canvas, not a document. Sections alternate between Brutalism mode (raw, structural, dark) and Neobrutalism mode (color-shocked, hard-shadowed, slightly playful). Each section runs in exactly one mode — never both.
laws: I. Tokens or it didn't happen. No magic numbers in components.
II. CSS until proven otherwise. Total JS budget for design effects: 15KB gz.
III. The page is a canvas. Asymmetric by default. Symmetry is a fallback we don't fall back to.

modes.brutalism: Heavy, raw, structural. Ink + Bone palette. Accent ≤ 5% of pixels. Hairline borders. No shadows. Snap easing. Index marks ([01], [02]). Used for: hero, manifesto, case studies, footer.
modes.neobrutalism: Color-shocked, three-dimensional through hard offsets. Bone + Accent + 1 secondary. Accent ≥ 30% of pixels. Thick borders (2–3px). Hard offset shadows mandatory. Spring easing allowed. Stickers, rotation 4–8°. Used for: services, process, pricing, CTA.

tokenArchitecture._comment: Three-layer token model. Components consume SEMANTIC tokens. Semantic tokens reference PRIMITIVES. Never bypass layers.

primitive._comment: Raw values. Never consumed directly by components.

typography._comment: Font stacks. Mono is a first-class face — used for metadata, captions, code, brutalist annotations.
typography.mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

fluidSize._comment: Fluid clamp() values. Min viewport 320px, max 1440px. Body scale = Minor Third (1.200). Display scale = Golden (1.618).

spacing._comment: 4pt grid. space-4 (16px) is the base unit. Section block padding = space-10 minimum. Hero block padding = space-11.

radius._comment: Brutalism prefers 0. Neobrutalism allows sm/md. No xl — blob corners are banned.

semantic._comment: Intent layer. Components consume these. Reference primitives only.

type._comment: Semantic shorthand combining family + size + weight + leading. Consumed via CSS `font` shorthand.

motion._comment: Each easing has one job. Modes restrict which easings are allowed.

border._comment: Hairline = 1px Brutalism default. Strong = 2px. Thick = 3px Neobrutalist chunk. Accent = colored.

shadow._comment: Hard offset shadows are the Neobrutalism signature. NEVER apply to body text or section containers. Stack is loudest — once per page max.

component._comment: Component-local aliases. Used by individual primitives in src/components/primitives/.

magneticButton._comment: Neobrutalist primary CTA — thick border, hard shadow, spring on hover, depress on active.

brutalistButton._comment: Brutalist secondary — hairline border, hard inversion on hover, snap easing.

sticker._comment: Neobrutalist accent block. Rotates -4deg by default. Use ≤ 2 per section.

eyebrow._comment: Section labels with leading accent rule.

frame._comment: Aspect-locked media container. Hover scales image 1.06.

card._comment: Cards are mode-aware. Default is Brutalism (hairline only). Add .card-neobrutalist for the loud version.

snake._comment: PremiumSnake background effect. Consumes motion tokens, never defines.

modeRules._comment: Per-mode constraints. The decision matrix from design-system.md §1. Use these to gate which tokens a section may consume.

asymmetricPostures._comment: 8 named layout postures. Every section uses one — no improvisation. Sequencing rule: never repeat a posture twice in a row.

leftHeavy.effect: Anchor weight on left, paragraph hangs right

verticalAxis.heading: col1 rotate-90
verticalAxis.effect: Heading runs vertically up the gutter

color._comment: Flat-shape view of the palette for legacy Tailwind consumers. NEW components should consume semantic tokens via CSS variables, not these.

status._comment: Status colors mapped onto the warm brown palette.

border._comment: Warm-on-dark transparency border tokens for subtle UI dividers in dark sections.

shadow._comment: Hard offset shadow colors — the Neobrutalist signature.

typography._comment: Fluid type system. Body scale = Minor Third (1.200). Display scale = Golden (1.618). Mono is first-class — used for metadata, captions, brutalist annotations.

scale._comment: Fluid clamp() values, generated from min 320px → max 1440px viewport.

hero._comment: Once per page. Display-xl + black weight + display tracking.

h1._comment: Section opener (when not the hero). Display-lg + black weight.

h2._comment: Major section heading. Display-md + black weight.

h3._comment: Card and subsection heading. Display-sm + black weight.

h4._comment: Minor heading — feature titles, pricing tier names. text-lg + bold.

h5._comment: Small heading — sidebar titles, accordion headers. text-md + bold.

h6._comment: Micro heading — metadata labels, table headers. text-base + bold.

lead._comment: Hero subheading / intro paragraph. text-md + regular.

body._comment: Default body. Capped at 60ch line length. text-base + regular.

bodyLarge._comment: Compatibility alias for existing Tailwind utility (.type-body-large). Mirrors lead scale.

bodySmall._comment: Small body — supporting copy, footnotes. text-sm + regular.

caption._comment: Image captions, timestamps, helper text. Mono — brutalist treatment.

eyebrow._comment: Section labels, status badges, metric labels. Mono + uppercase + allcaps tracking.

label._comment: Form labels, nav links. Mono + medium.

labelUppercase._comment: Same as eyebrow but tinted to fg (not muted). Used on active states.

labelSmall._comment: Compatibility alias for tiny uppercase labels used in badges/captions.

meta._comment: Brutalist annotation — coordinates, version stamps, build numbers, [01] index marks.

mono._comment: Inline code, version strings, technical metadata.

button._comment: All button labels — uppercase, allcaps tracking, mono. Used on CTAs and nav buttons.

mark._comment: Highlighted phrase inside body copy — Neobrutalist <mark> styling.

rules._comment: Universal typography rules applied via base.css.

spacing._comment: 4pt grid (NOT 8pt). space-4 (16px) is base unit. Section block padding = space-10 (128px) minimum. Hero block padding = space-11 (192px). No half-tokens — if 1.25rem feels right, the answer is space-5 or space-6.

borderOpacity._comment: Tailwind opacity modifier scale for cream-on-dark borders.

effects._comment: Motion tokens — 5 durations, 5 easings, stagger ramp. Each easing has one job. See modeRules for which easings each mode permits.

transition._comment: Map of named transitions for backwards-compatible Tailwind consumers. New code consumes via semantic.motion.* tokens.

duration._comment: 5 tiers, no in-betweens. cinematic = hero/section reveals. base = state changes. fast = hover/focus. instant = button press. slow = panel reveals.

stagger._comment: Stagger delays for sequential elements. Use in .reveal-stagger > * via nth-child.

delay._comment: Compound delays for staggered entrance children.

enterFrom._comment: Standard entrance state. .reveal applies opacity:0 + translateY(24px), animates to identity.

depth._comment: Z-axis depth for 3D layering. Requires perspective-1k on parent.

magnetic._comment: Magnetic CTA — pointer-tracking translate on label. Desktop + fine pointer + non-reduced-motion only.

parallax._comment: CSS-driven parallax via custom properties (--px, --py). Background slowest, foreground fastest.

grain._comment: SVG fractal noise overlay — fixed, pointer-events:none, mix-blend-mode:overlay, on hero only.

shadowHard._comment: Neobrutalist hard offset shadow. NEVER on body text or section containers. Use stack ≤ 1 per page.

border._comment: Brutalism uses 1px hairline default. Neobrutalism uses 2–3px chunky borders. Radius is 0 by default; sm/md only allowed in Neobrutalism mode.

cursor._comment: Crosshair fallback for non-fine pointers. CustomCursor.astro replaces it on (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).

grid._comment: 12-column canvas grid. 4-column overlay (0.06 opacity) is a visual debug aid only — not the layout grid.

animation._comment: Named animations. Marquee = 30s linear infinite. Reveal = .reveal class + IntersectionObserver pattern.

stickerBounce._comment: Neobrutalist sticker entrance — rotation + spring scale.

pressDown._comment: Active state on all clickable elements. Mandatory tactility.

zIndex._comment: Strict z-index scale. Components must never use a value outside this scale. If you need a number between two tiers, the design is wrong.

_legacyAliases._comment: Tailwind-compatible aliases for backwards compatibility. New code uses the named scale above.

media._comment: Three breakpoints (preserved from v1 spec). sm=mobile, md=tablet, lg=desktop. Fluid type means most things adapt without media queries.

rules.magneticRequires: (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and not (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)

performance._comment: Performance budget — enforced via build-time check.

accessibility._comment: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum. Brutalism is not an excuse to skip a11y.
accessibility.reducedContrast: prefers-contrast: more — hairlines bumped to bone-300
accessibility.headingHierarchy: One h1 per page, no skipped levels
accessibility.rotationIsAesthetic: Sticker rotation does not affect DOM order or screen-reader output

components._comment: Component-level defaults. These are starting points — primitives in src/components/primitives/ may override via tokens.

magneticButton._comment: Neobrutalist primary CTA. Thick border + hard shadow + spring + magnetic effect.

brutalistButton._comment: Brutalist secondary. Hairline + hard color inversion on hover. Snap easing.

sticker._comment: Neobrutalist accent block. -4deg default rotation. Use ≤ 2 per section.

card._comment: Brutalist mode default. Add modifier .card-neobrutalist for the loud version.

eyebrow._comment: Section labels with leading accent rule.

frame._comment: Aspect-locked media container with hover scale.

layout._comment: Global layout constraints. Container widths align to spec §6.

tailwindIntegration._comment: How Tailwind should consume these tokens. Tailwind reads from CSS variables — never the other way around. This block documents the mapping.

deprecated._comment: Tokens removed in v2.1 with migration notes.
deprecated.spacingBase_8px: Replaced by 4pt grid (space-4 = 16px is base unit).
deprecated.borderRadius_zeroEverywhere: Brutalism still defaults to 0; Neobrutalism allows sm (2px) and md (6px). Decided per mode.
deprecated.transitionBase_19_22: Replaced by easeOut (0.16, 1, 0.30, 1). Single signature curve.
deprecated.duration_300ms: Replaced by base (240ms). Five named tiers only — no in-betweens.
deprecated.stagger_8ms: Too tight to read. Replaced by stagger ramp (60/120/220/400ms).
deprecated.defaultCardBorder_blackOpacity: Dark-first system uses cream-on-dark. Use --color-hairline (ink-500) instead.

v2.1.0_BrutalistCanvas: Added _doc block describing philosophy, three laws, and dual-mode identity.
Added modeRules (Brutalism vs Neobrutalism) — gates which tokens each mode may consume.
Added asymmetricPostures — 8 named layout postures with grid placements.
Expanded primitive.color with accent2_*, signalYellow, signalBlue.
Added semantic.color.accent2, accent2Fg, mark, markFg, shadowAccent, shadowAccent2.
Replaced fixed-size type tokens with fluid clamp() scale (Minor Third body + Golden display).
Added semantic.type.* shorthand combining family + size + weight + leading + tracking.
Added primitive.motion with easing (5 curves), duration (5 tiers), stagger (4 widths).
Added easeSnap for Brutalist hard cuts.
Added shadow.hardSm/Md/Lg + accentSm/Md/Lg + accent2Md + stack (Neobrutalist signatures).
Added border.hairlineThick (3px) for Neobrutalist chunky borders.
Switched spacing base from 8px to 4px (4pt grid).
Container max changed from 1400px to 96rem (1536px).
Added z-index named scale (effects/content/overlap/sticky/overlay/modal/toast/cursor).
Added semantic.shadow tokens (hardSm/Md/Lg + accentSm/Md/Lg + stack).
Added component primitives: magneticButton, brutalistButton, sticker, eyebrow, frame, marquee, slab.
Added typography.mark for <mark> Neobrutalist highlight.
Added typography.meta for brutalist annotations ([01], coordinates, build versions).
Added performance budgets (LCP, CLS, INP, JS budget, CSS budget).
Added tailwindIntegration block documenting Tailwind ↔ tokens.css contract.
Added deprecated block listing v1 tokens removed and their migrations.
